claims.statement: For a rooted finite forest (G,r), attaching a pendant path P_m at r gives I(G_m)=I(G-r)P_m+zI(G-N[r])P_(m-1); consequently this two-polynomial boundary state computes the exact strict Delta_p selector test at every rank for each surviving original leaf after the operation, while tracking the new endpoint separately.
claims.scope: Fixed-rank strict favorable-leaf selector under pendant-path attachment at a specified root in finite ordinary trees; includes all old original leaf tags other than the root when it was a leaf, plus the new endpoint. No eligibility or primary aggregate conclusion.
claims.reason: Independent-set partition by root occupancy proves the polynomial identity and coefficient selector formula. The exact K1,7 calculation demonstrates that selector membership need not be preserved; all primary eligibility guards and the global sum remain outside the lemma.

limitations: The recurrence does not show preservation of the alpha/x/p eligibility guards or the strict lower-region inequality.
The sign-change example is outside primary eligibility and does not refute the primary aggregate.
No bound is established for changes in the complete selected sum S.
